description: PWR fuel and core geometry database for FLARE plant_design selection.

selection_rule.explicit: Match plant_design against a design key, display name, or alias.
selection_rule.automatic: When plant_design is omitted or set to auto, select the auto-eligible design with reference_thermal_power_MWt closest to total_power.

boundary_condition_extension.purpose: Optional plant-specific defaults for existing FLARE input parameters. Values may be scalar or objects containing value, basis, and target_sheet.
boundary_condition_extension.precedence: Applied after the initiating-event template and legacy plant_geometry values, but before PRA branch, hazard-context, and explicit user overrides.
boundary_condition_extension.missing_data_policy: Retain the event-template value only as an explicitly identified reference-plant fallback. List every inherited parameter in the generated deck and manifest; do not identify it as selected-plant data.
boundary_condition_extension.system_geometry_precedence: The selected design system_geometry is primary. Runtime/plant_geometry.json remains a backward-compatible fallback for records not yet consolidated.
